issuing_body: United States Attorney's Office, District of Minnesota (motion reproduced by third-party archive)
title: Government's second motion for preliminary forfeiture as to Ahmed Sharif Omar-Hashim, ECF 868

acquisition.channel: Third-party reproduced text of motion; PDF not independently downloaded

supports: Government represented in its May 14, 2026 motion that property at 2722/2742 Park Avenue South belonged to Cosmopolitan Business Properties LLC and that its ownership was shared among Said, Salah and Omar-Hashim.
Government asserted Omar-Hashim's share was 20 percent and the asset had already been named in Said's ECF 805 preliminary forfeiture order.
Government described a July 23, 2021 purchase price of $2,780,000; this is purchase-price evidence alleged in the motion, not realized recovery.
does_not_support: An independently established current property value, sale price or government cash realization.
That the motion's ownership allegations alone adjudicate rights of all third parties.
An amount to add across the orders listing the same property.
locators: Reproduced motion pp. 1–3 including reference to ECF 805 and ownership
notes: This government motion is primary evidence of what prosecutors asserted, but not judicial proof of every ownership or use-of-funds allegation. Order ECF 874 independently recognizes Omar-Hashim's 20 percent interest.
